name: Masochistic Rage suffers self damage and enrages
contract: Masochistic Rage 803030 promises a 1 sec delay then self damage and a 20% damage-dealt buff for 15 sec. Its single effect is native SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_TRIGGER_SPELL_DELAYED (183, SpellEffects.cpp:499 Spell::EffectAscensionTriggerSpellDelayed), which triggers 570097 after the delay. 570097 is itself fully native: EFFECT_0 SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE (self, EffectBasePoints 419 + DieSides 19 => matches $AP*0.36 formula) and EFFECT_1 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (EffectBasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = 20%). Effect 183 and both native effects on 570097 need no CoA registration; #3712-style zero-hits-in-source is expected here too.
